newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar lower after correction.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar lower after correction.

text.p: London's white sugar futures maintained their softer tone in late trading on Thursday following the day's downward correction from Wednesday's sharp rally.
The May contract stood at $311.00, down $1.30, at the LIFFE close. But it was off the day's lows of $309.10.
August was $1.40 weaker at $310.60 and overall volume totalled 1,954 lots.

Both the whites and the raws markets corrected lower after Wednesday's late fund-led buying spree pushed March raws up 33 points to 11.27 cents/lb and May whites up $4.80 to $312.30. But the sudden strength lured sellers eager to take profits on Thursday and the spot value quickly moved lower.
New York followed the same pattern and just compounded the London weakness, traders said.
